title: Monday Quick Tip
subtitle: How long is too long
hook: When do your youngest players start to fade?
intro: Practice is scheduled for ninety minutes.
At minute fifty, the six-year-olds are done.
statement: Attention runs out before the schedule does.
q1: Do you keep practices short for young players —
q2: or use the full time with more breaks?
q3: What happens in the last twenty minutes?
t1: Both can work. But young players learn more
t2: when practice ends while they still want more.
cta: Coaches — how long are your practices?
ctaLines: Forty-five minutes. An hour. Full time with breaks.
Short and sharp or long with breaks?
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
When do your youngest players start to fade?
Practice is scheduled for ninety minutes. At minute fifty, the six-year-olds are done.
Attention runs out before the schedule does.
Shorter practices or full time with breaks. Every team is different.
How long are your practices? Share your habit in the comments.
